fields.name: OwnerPrincipalType
fields.about: The principal type of the owner of the token. If it's null it defaults to the token request principal.

fields.name: OwnerPrincipalName
fields.about: The principal name of the owner of the token. If it's null it defaults to the token request principal.

fields.name: Renewers
fields.about: A list of those who are allowed to renew this token before it expires.

fields.name: PrincipalType
fields.about: The type of the Kafka principal.

fields.name: PrincipalName
fields.about: The name of the Kafka principal.

fields.name: MaxLifetimeMs
fields.about: The maximum lifetime of the token in milliseconds, or -1 to use the server side default.
